facts.text: FlyCraft is a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning environment for fixed-wing UAV velocity vector control based on Gymnasium
FlyCraft-v0 is registered with entry point flycraft.env:FlyCraftEnv
FlyCraft-Level-Turn-v0 is registered with entry point flycraft.env_level_turn:FlyCraftLevelTurnEnv
The observation space is a Dict of three Boxes named observation, desired_goal and achieved_goal
The observation vector is ordered phi, theta, psi, v, mu, chi, p, h
The observation lower bounds are phi -180, theta -90, psi -180, v 0, mu -90, chi -180, p -300 and h 0
The observation upper bounds are phi 180, theta 90, psi 180, v 1000, mu 90, chi 180, p 300 and h 20000
The desired and achieved goal vector is [v, mu, chi] with bounds v 0 to 1000, mu -90 to 90 and chi -180 to 180
The action space is a Box built from F16Plane.get_action_lower_bounds and get_action_higher_bounds for the configured control mode
In guidance_law_mode the action is [p, nz, pla] with bounds p -180 to 180, nz -4 to 9 and pla 0 to 1
In end_to_end_mode the action is [ail, ele, rud, pla] with bounds ail -21.5 to 21.5, ele -25 to 25, rud -30 to 30 and pla 0 to 1
The plane's step time is 1/step_frequence seconds
The default NMR configuration sets step_frequence to 10
reset(seed, options) reseeds the task and goal sampler when a seed is given, resets the plane and the task, and returns (observation, info)
step(action) returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
The timeout termination reports terminated and truncated when step_cnt >= max_episode_steps - 1
Upstream needs dynamic *.so/*.dll libraries and documents Linux or Windows only

determinism.notes: the fake draws the goal from Python's random.Random(seed) and its state update is deterministic, so one seed plus one action sequence repeats a trajectory on this fake; upstream draws from numpy's Generator through its goal sampler, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two implementations

gaps: F0: the F16 flight dynamics, control law and aerodynamic model are not modelled by the fake; its observation update is a kinematic placeholder and makes no claim about forces, motion or contacts

the reward and termination rules of the fake are simplified: upstream combines the dense reward with reach-target, crash, extreme-state, timeout, continuously-move-away, continuously-roll and negative-overload/big-phi terminations; the fake models only the timeout truncation
the fake draws a uniform goal with Python's random.Random; upstream uses numpy's Generator and the configured goal sampler (fixed goal, random range or the available-goals file) with optional noise
timestep_ms 100 is the default NMR.json step_frequence of 10 Hz; a custom_config or config_file can change step_frequence, and the contract does not follow it
the fake serves the default guidance_law_mode action [p, nz, pla]; an end_to_end_mode configuration (the four values ail, ele, rud, pla) is not modelled

the upstream environment needs platform-specific compiled libraries and is documented as Linux or Windows only; it was never imported or run here, so the fake was not compared with it and returns Python lists where upstream returns float32 numpy arrays
snapshot and restore are not offered: FlyCraftEnv exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
